correctness.rationale: The proof independently reconstructs path cavity ODE the cavity derivative equation, the exact new-leaf/center/arm occupation changes, and their bivariate generating function. Direct coefficient integration gives a signed rational array with absolute majorant 2^(p+q)/(p!q!), implying both claimed limits and explicit factorial errors. The strict c_(j+1)<2c_j/(j+1) alternating sequence proves uniqueness at fixed depth two, while integration yields both constants. The packaged no-dependency checker compared 36 finite coefficient formulas with a direct first-arrival recursion, exhaustively checked additional small vertex orderings, and passed 62 assertions total. No infinite statement is based on finite tests. Scope is fixed-depth boundary limit and both-arm bulk limit.

value.rationale: The exact branch penalty quantifies an order-one perturbation to an extremal random-greedy adsorption path, which disappears under the usual normalized local limit. The unexpected unique shallow-depth-two minimum and distinct universal interior constant supply a complete, naturally motivated boundary-to-bulk sensitivity profile and factorial convergence bounds. This is stronger than a routine positive-gap check or a mere formula for one tiny graph.
